prod_vs_preprod.summary: Preprod DRIFT reproduces on production. The count-vs-rows/pagination mechanics are actually sound at scale: on the 1,168-case recursive stress test, info.count correctly reported 1,168 (matching the known true total) while a single page correctly returned page_size (100) rows with next=2 to continue — no desync, unlike the sibling list_test_plans_by_integer_id defect. The real, confirmed drift is test_case_steps: declared as a nested object, but production returned an empty array on all 219 sampled rows, including many rows whose step_count (1-11) and template (test_case_steps/test_case_bdd) prove they DO have real step content that the response is silently omitting/misrepresenting. All undeclared-but-returned fields from the preprod probe reproduced verbatim in prod. status/case_type stayed null everywhere probed, so their declared {field_name,...} shape remains unverified rather than confirmed or refuted.

notes: Read-only probe against a real project (PR-18723 / 332537); nothing written or mutated. Large responses (100-row pages) were saved to disk by the tool harness and post-processed with regex/counts rather than loaded whole into context, due to the 190KB+ payload sizes on folder 40231630.
